Quarterly Financial Report Pursuant To Paragraph 9.22 Of The Main Market Listing Requirements Of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad
Back
Dec 29, 2025

 

Type	Announcement
Subject	OTHERS

Description	Quarterly Financial Report pursuant to Paragraph 9.22 of the Main Market Listing Requirements of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad

Please be informed that Bursa Malaysia Berhad has scheduled to release its financial results for the fourth quarter ended 31 December 2025 on Thursday, 29 January 2026 in accordance with Paragraph 9.22 of the Main Market Listing Requirements of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

This announcement is dated 29 December 2025.
